positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: In this group project, we created a Java compiler from scratch, able to go through for loops, while loops, if statements, and switch statements. The compiler was able to recognize basic data types as well as able to convert variables into other data types. On top of that, the program is able to recognize built-in functions and user-created functions.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
In this group project, we implemented our own versions of the Decision Tree
classifier, Random Forest classifier, and the Naïve Bayes classifier. We compared the results of their performance against SciKit’s implementations. For these algorithms, the Red Wine Quality dataset provided by Kaggle was used.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description: In this group project, we created a website for a client as well as creating a functional iOS/Android app for women’s health. The app uses simple-to-use navigational buttons and stores a user’s information to an AWS database, including email, password, date of birth, and menstrual history.

projects.title: Main Nintendo Titles VS Spin-offs
projects.description:
•	Acquired the company’s annual sales reports (2004-2014) from its official website
•	Analyzed growth rates of several Nintendo franchises such as the Super Mario, the Legend of Zelda, and the Pokémon series
•	Compared the growth rate of video games sold by the main series to the growth rate of video games sold by derivative games of the main series, also known as “spin-offs” 
•	Concluded that spin-offs have a higher growth rate despite the main series selling more units overall
